name: Oogami Toramaru
source:
2nd year high school student. Ryuumaru's older twin brother.
A member of an old and well known werewolf family.
He has a leader type personality and great fighting prowess.
He takes pride in his family's duty to protect the Sainoyama region.
Hobby/Special Skill: Rock Collecting
